# Groovemap

> Groovemap is a drum-pattern encyclopedia: 4,105 authentic drum patterns across 38 style families — rock, funk, jazz, bossa, samba, reggae, hip-hop, trap, house, jungle, drill, Balkan odd meters, Indian talas and more. Every pattern is a step-event grid with velocities, construction notes, per-instrument roles, variations, provenance, an ASCII drum tab and references — playable in the browser and fully machine-readable. This site is optimized for LLM consumption: open REST API, MCP server, robots-allowed AI crawlers.

## Catalog

- 4,105 patterns · 38 style families · 441 genre tags
- 17 meters: 4/4 (3819), 7/8 (47), 10/8 (27), 3/4 (24), 9/8 (23), 5/8 (22), 11/8 (22), 5/4 (21), 8/4 (21), 2/4 (19), 7/4 (12), 6/4 (11), 10/4 (11), 12/4 (11), 14/4 (11), 12/8 (2), 6/8 (2)
- 7 recorded sample kits (no synth drums): studio (1248), tight (709), analog808 (485), analog909 (448), dusty (522), synth (172), perc (521)
- Feels: straight (2964), swung (696), shuffled (208), broken (186), triplet (51)
- BPM range 50–290
- 15 curated collections (e.g. "First Beats to Learn", "Foundational Dance Grooves")
- Family keys: rock, pop, metal, punk, country, gospel, blues, funk, rnb, disco, jazz, bossa, samba, latin, reggae, ska, hiphop, trap, lofi, house, garage, jungle, breaks, techno, dubstep, afrobeat, world, experimental, learn, synthwave, fills, indian, arabic, balkan, caribbean, african, drill, club
- Live totals: `GET /api/v1/stats`

## REST API (base: /api/v1)

All endpoints are GET, read-only, JSON, CORS-open. Every response carries a `meta` block (service, endpoint, docs, next-step hint), sends CORS `*` and `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300` on stable GETs.
Full reference: [source docs](/api/v1/README.md) · machine discovery: `GET /api/v1?format=text`.

- [GET /api/v1](/api/v1): discovery document (endpoint list + catalog summary); `?format=text` for markdown.
- [GET /api/v1/patterns](/api/v1/patterns): search/list patterns — returns `{ total, count, offset, items }` of compact cards.
- [GET /api/v1/patterns/{id}](/api/v1/patterns/backbeat-basic): one pattern, complete — events grid, learning notes, knowledge, drum tab, references, related.
- [GET /api/v1/families](/api/v1/families): all style families with counts, meters, BPM ranges, sample ids.
- [GET /api/v1/families/{key}](/api/v1/families/funk): family knowledge + its patterns (`?limit=`).
- [GET /api/v1/random](/api/v1/random): random pattern(s), `?count=1..10`.
- [GET /api/v1/collections](/api/v1/collections): 15 curated collections (`?items=1` embeds patterns).
- [GET /api/v1/stats](/api/v1/stats): catalog totals.

## MCP server (Model Context Protocol)

Streamable HTTP transport, JSON-RPC 2.0, single endpoint. Connect any MCP client:

- Gateway path: `/mcp?XTransformPort=3121` (relative to this site's origin)
- Local: `http://127.0.0.1:3121/mcp`
- Handshake: `POST /mcp {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-03-26"}}`
- Tools: `search_patterns`, `get_pattern`, `list_families`, `get_family`, `random_pattern`, `get_stats`, `list_collections`, `export_pattern_midi_b64`
- Tool results are LLM-optimized text blocks (compact cards, ASCII tabs, base64 MIDI).

## Crawl & index

- robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, CCBot, Google-Extended and other AI agents — everything on this site is meant to be read.
- Expanded reference (every family + full parameter tables + example responses): [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt)

## Example queries

- "Show me advanced funk patterns with ghost notes" → `GET /api/v1/patterns?family=funk&difficulty=advanced&q=ghost`
- "Something between 120 and 130 BPM in 4/4" → `GET /api/v1/patterns?meter=4/4&bpm_min=120&bpm_max=130`
- "What is a karsilama?" → `GET /api/v1/patterns/karsilama-9-8` (9/8 Balkan timeline, with story + tab)
- "Pick a random groove" → `GET /api/v1/random?count=3`
- "Export the basic rock beat as MIDI" → MCP `export_pattern_midi_b64 {id: "backbeat-basic"}`

## Licensing & provenance

Pattern data (step grids, original descriptions, learning notes) is by Groovemap and free to quote with attribution. Entries are original study compositions, documented common-practice skeletons (`source.type: "reference"`), or traditional timelines (`"traditional"`) presented with cultural context — every pattern carries an honest `source` label. Traditional rhythms belong to their living traditions.

# Full reference (llms-full.txt)

### /api/v1/patterns parameters

| Param | Values | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| limit | 1–200 | 50 | page size |
| offset | ≥ 0 | 0 | pagination |
| family | csv of family keys | — | e.g. `funk`, `jungle,house` |
| genre | csv of genre tags | — | e.g. `Jazz` (case-insensitive) |
| q | text | — | full-text over title/summary/description/family/genres/tags |
| meter | "num/den" | — | e.g. `4/4`, `7/8`, `12/8` |
| feel | csv | — | straight, swung, shuffled, triplet, broken |
| difficulty | csv | — | beginner, intermediate, advanced |
| bpm_min / bpm_max | number | — | filter the pattern's canonical BPM |
| bars | number | — | exact bar count (1, 2…) |
| subdivision | 1/2/3/4/6 | — | 4 = 16ths, 3 = triplets, 2 = 8ths |
| sort | bpm, difficulty, family, id | catalog order | |
| fields | compact, full | compact | full adds description, tags, tracks, events, learning, variations, related |

### Example response — GET /api/v1/patterns?family=rock&limit=1

```json
{
  "id": "backbeat-basic",
  "title": "Basic Rock Backbeat",
  "family": "rock",
  "bpm": 96,
  "timeSignature": "4/4",
  "bars": 1,
  "subdivision": 4,
  "feel": "straight",
  "swing": 0,
  "tracks": [
    {
      "id": "kick",
      "inst": "kick",
      "vol": 1
    },
    {
      "id": "snare",
      "inst": "snare",
      "vol": 0.9
    },
    {
      "id": "hatClosed",
      "inst": "hatClosed",
      "vol": 0.6
    }
  ],
  "events": [
    {
      "t": "kick",
      "s": 0,
      "v": 127
    },
    {
      "t": "kick",
      "s": 8,
      "v": 127
    },
    {
      "t": "snare",
      "s": 4,
      "v": 127
    },
    {
      "t": "snare",
      "s": 12,
      "v": 127
    },
    {
      "t": "hatClosed",
      "s": 0,
      "v": 127
    },
    {
      "t": "hatClosed",
      "s": 2,
      "v": 100
    }
  ],
  "eventsNote": "…12 events total ({ t, s, v, p?, r? })",
  "learning": {
    "construction": "Layer 1: straight eighth hi-hats. Layer 2: kick on beats 1 and 3. Layer 3: snare on beats 2 and 4. Nothing is syncopated…",
    "roles": "…per-instrument notes"
  },
  "source": {
    "type": "reference",
    "note": "Common-practice pattern; the standard rock backbeat taught in virtually every drum method."
  }
}
```

Compact item shape (every list endpoint):

```json
{
  "id": "backbeat-basic",
  "title": "Basic Rock Backbeat",
  "family": "rock",
  "genres": ["Rock", "Pop"],
  "bpm": 96,
  "timeSignature": "4/4",
  "feel": "straight",
  "difficulty": "beginner",
  "bars": 1,
  "subdivision": 4,
  "swing": 0,
  "summary": "The anchor of popular music: kick on 1 & 3, snare on 2 & 4, straight eighth hats.",
  "stepCount": 16,
  "hitCount": 12,
  "kit": "studio"
}
```

### Reading the grid

- `events[]` = `{ t: trackId, s: absoluteStep, v: velocity 1-127, p?: probability, r?: ratchet rolls }`
- absolute step = `bar × stepsPerBar + positionInBar`; `stepsPerBar = beatsPerBar × subdivision`
- velocity tiers: ≥120 accent (X), ≥75 normal (x), else ghost (o); drum-tab legend: `X x o 2/3/4 rolls, p probabilistic, - rest`
- `notation.drumTab.rows` = `{ inst, label, bars: [one char per step per bar] }` with `counts` per bar — render top-to-bottom as an ASCII tab
- exports: `export_pattern_midi_b64` (MCP) returns base64 of a General-MIDI Type-0 .mid (channel 10, 480 PPQ, tempo + time-signature meta)

## All curated collections (15)

- `first-beats` — "First Beats to Learn" (6 patterns): Start here: simple, satisfying grooves that teach the fundamentals. — ids: build-01-kick-quarters, build-02-eighth-hats, backbeat-basic, hiphop-oldschool, reggae-one-drop, build-03-sixteenth-hats
- `dance-floor` — "Foundational Dance Grooves" (6 patterns): Four-on-the-floor DNA from disco to techno. — ids: disco-classic, house-basic, techno-basic, deep-house, disco-strings, garage-4x4
- `funk-syncopation` — "Funk & Syncopation" (6 patterns): Ghost notes, displaced kicks and the fine art of the one. — ids: funk-16ths, funk-jb, motown-groove, breaks-funky, breaks-think, funk-open-push
- `broken-grooves` — "Broken & Swung" (5 patterns): UK garage, broken beat and the jungle chop. — ids: ukg-2step, broken-beat, garage-4x4, jungle-two-step, dnb-rolling
- `odd-meters` — "Odd Meters & Timelines" (5 patterns): 3/4 to 12/8 — rhythms that refuse the four-count. — ids: waltz-backbeat, five-four-take, seven-eight-rupcha, karsilama-9-8, ewe-bell
- `sparse-minimal` — "Sparse & Minimal" (5 patterns): Less is a rhythm section: space as an instrument. — ids: minimal-click, techno-basic, reggae-one-drop, soul-slow, lofi-hop
- `dense-percussion` — "Dense Percussion" (5 patterns): When every sixteenth has a voice. — ids: afrobeat-busy, samba-batucada, funk-16ths, jungle-two-step, trap-rolling
- `live-foundations` — "Live-Band Foundations" (6 patterns): Acoustic grooves for bands, singers and songwriters. — ids: backbeat-basic, rock-drive, soul-slow, jazz-brush, jazz-swing, motown-groove
- `building-blocks` — "Rhythm Building Exercises" (6 patterns): The Learn-series patterns in playing order. — ids: build-01-kick-quarters, build-02-eighth-hats, build-03-sixteenth-hats, build-04-offbeat, build-05-ghosts, build-06-fill
- `math-rhythms` — "Mathematical Rhythms" (4 patterns): Euclidean generators, cross-rhythms and probability. — ids: euclid-sketch, polyrhythm-3-4, idm-glitch, ewe-bell
- `roots-american` — "Roots: Blues, Country & Gospel" (7 patterns): Shuffles, train beats and shout-band fire — the American wellspring. — ids: blues-texas-shuffle, blues-12-8-slow, country-train-beat, country-two-step, gospel-shout, gospel-12-8, rock-bo-diddley
- `heavy-units` — "Heavy Machinery" (6 patterns): Metal, punk and the double-kick discipline. — ids: metal-gallop, metal-double-kick, metal-blast-fragment, punk-d-beat, punk-straight-eighths, metal-half-time-thrash
- `atlantic-grooves` — "Atlantic Grooves: Bossa to Samba" (6 patterns): Bossa clave wisdom and samba ground motion. — ids: bossa-core, bossa-2-bar, samba-partido-alto, samba-reggae-olodum, samba-pandeiro, latin-rumba-guaguanco
- `street-140` — "Street & 140" (6 patterns): Drill, grime, dubstep and footwork — the halftime generation. — ids: hiphop-drill-uk, grime-eski, dubstep-halftime-140, footwork-juke, trap-south-bounce, dubstep-riddim
- `fills-phrasing` — "Fills & Phrasing" (6 patterns): Turnarounds, press rolls and chops that move a track. — ids: fill-rock-16th-toms, fill-press-roll, fill-linear-gospel, fill-dnb-ghost, fill-latin-conga-call, fill-boom-bap-2bar

## MCP tools reference

- `search_patterns` — args: family?, genre?, q?, bpm_min?, bpm_max?, difficulty?, limit? → compact cards
- `get_pattern` — args: id → metadata + ASCII drum tab + construction + roles + story + references + related
- `list_families` — no args → 38 families with counts/meters/BPM
- `get_family` — args: key, limit? → family knowledge + patterns
- `random_pattern` — args: count? (1-10) → random cards
- `get_stats` — no args → catalog totals
- `list_collections` — no args → curated collections with ids
- `export_pattern_midi_b64` — args: id → base64 Type-0 MIDI (.mid) for download
